gaps.explanation: Printed rounding only; every line in both places is as printed. Statement p5 lines add to 1,083,950 (General functions 942,072 + debt service 141,878); the printed Total expenditures is 1,083,951. Detail = p13 combining-schedule department object cells + Bond Fund 141,878 (p11) = 1,083,956. On p13 the printed department totals add to 942,073, but the object cells of five departments differ from their printed totals: General 27,583+2,526+1,995+33,758+1,608+2,293+20,207+4,880+1,283+6,425+720+5,995+13,629+7,472 = 130,374 vs printed 130,372 (+2); Recycling 13,238+1,013+2,654+201+2,488+904 = 20,498 vs 20,496 (+2); Streets 185,328 vs 185,327 (+1); Parks 176,138 vs 176,139 (-1); Library 83,154 vs 83,153 (+1). Cells add to 942,078 = printed 942,073 + 5, and the statement lines are 1 under the printed total: 942,078 - 942,072 = 6 = the gap. There is no missing or duplicate line, so there is nothing to fix.
